text:
mike-runtime: Quick sync — planning to enable prefetch_v2 + batch_scheduler_v3 for 10% canary starting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need final signoffs on metrics, rollback plan, and canary audience.

jenn-eng: +1, thanks. Can we confirm the exact feature flags and how to scope the 10%? e.g. `flags.prefetch_v2: users=10pct; env=prod`?

kevin-sre: Please include these SLO/metrics for the canary: p50/p95 latency for gen calls, tokens/sec, model QPS, and KV-hit-rate. Also watch eviction-rate and GPU memory OOMs.

mike-runtime: Flag names: `prefetch_v2_enabled` and `batch_scheduler_v3` (both boolean). We'll roll together. Audience will be 10% of traffic by user_id hash bucket (range 0-9). Docs: /runbooks/rollouts/prefetch_v2.md (will upload).

sarah-ops: For the 10% audience, prefer rolling by region slices to avoid regional hotspots — start with us-west-2 + eu-west-1 both at 5% each. If stable after 2 hours, expand.

lucy-qa: What perf validation thresholds should gate expansion? Suggest: p95 increase <= 10% vs baseline, KV-hit-rate >= 85%, and no CPU/GPU memory >75% sustained. Also no error-rate spike >0.5% absolute.

jenn-eng: Agree with lucy. Add synthetic smoke tests hitting typical prompt lengths (<=512 tokens) and long prompts (~2k tokens) before flip. I can add a small canary job that runs every 5m.

kevin-sre: Rollback trigger checklist I want in the runbook: 1) p95 > baseline + 10% for 5 consecutive 1m windows, 2) KV-hit-rate drop >10pct, 3) any OOM or node eviction, 4) user-facing error-rate >0.5% for 3m. If triggered, toggle flags off, route traffic to stable model variant, and open incident channel #incidents.

mike-runtime: Good. For observability we'll emit a rollout tag: `rollout=prefetch_v2_canary_2026_03_18`. Add tag to traces and metrics so we can slice.

sarah-ops: Also add a gradual rollback path: if partial degradation, reduce audience 10->3->0 with 15min waits. Only full toggle-off if severe.

lucy-qa: I'll own the smoke job and alerting thresholds in Datadog. Will add dashboard panels: KV-hit-rate by model, p95 latency by route, tokens/sec, and error-rate.

jenn-eng: Code review ping: PR #4523 has the flag plumbing. @kevin-sre can you approve the infra bits? It's small, adds the flag and metric tag.

kevin-sre: On it. I'll review today and request changes if anything touches infra limits.

mike-runtime: Deploy bot will run the canary enable. Plan: 09:00 UTC enable flags for region slices, 09:15 smoke tests, 09:30 evaluate metrics, 10:00 expand to 25% if green.

deploy-bot: reminder: scheduled job created -> `canary-enable-prefetch_v2` at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z. Notify @mike-runtime on completion.

sarah-ops: One more ask — document the fallback model variant name (model-serving:openai-compat-v2-fallback) and ensure routing rule exists before we flip.

mike-runtime: Noted. I'll add fallback into the runbook and pin the rollout ID in the canary job. Anything else?

jenn-eng: Please post final runbook link here once updated. Otherwise I'm good. :+1:

kevin-sre: Good to go from infra side once PR merged.

lucy-qa: I'll post the dashboard links and smoke run logs in this thread after tests.

mike-runtime: Thanks team — proceeding to merge and schedule. Will update thread with runbook link.

deploy-bot: done: PR #4523 merged by mike-runtime.
